title: Kenworth T409 SAR FUPS Road Train Bullbar #21
description: Kenworth T409 SAR Custom Built high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar. 76mm one piece heavy duty main cross pipes passing through drilled uprights for maximum strength, no butt welds (optional 88mm pipe). 100mm box uprights and custom designed heavy duty main channel with provision for front mudflaps. Reversible aluminium road train signs. Extra deep main channel. Heavy duty backing plate with 35mm tow pin. Driving light mounts fitted to customer requirements. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
